title: REQ · Boy sheet grids hold 14 frames of 32x48 with outlines and ramp shading
summary: Author idle 4, walk 6 and interact 4 frames at 32x48 in one sheet source
description: Context: ArtSource frames are palette-index grids; draw.ts offers createGrid, fillRect, outlineRect, shadeRect, dither, rampIndex. Desired: a boy in a blue hoodie with indigo outline drawn per frame. Expected: one ArtSource with 14 frames of 32 wide, 48 high. Why: the visual target requires an animated boy.
acceptance_criteria: Given BOY_SOURCES, when the sheet source is read, then it has exactly 14 frames each 48 rows by 32 columns
Given any frame, when its indices are checked, then every index is below PALETTE.length
Given idle, walk and interact frames, when compared, then frames within an animation differ from each other
technical_constraints: Shared palette of at most 48 colours
